scenario: My washing machine leaks when it drains. I am home after 7 p.m. on weekdays. I need to explain the problem to my building manager and ask about a repair.
opening: 洗濯機から水が漏れています。修理をお願いできますか？
openingMeaning: Water is leaking from my washing machine. Could I request a repair?

turns.japanese: 管理会社の田中です。どうされましたか？
turns.romaji: Kanri gaisha no Tanaka desu. Dō saremashita ka?
turns.meaning: This is Tanaka from the building management company. How can I help?
turns.note: どうされましたか is a polite way to ask what happened. This is your opening to explain the problem.
turns.answer: 洗濯機から水が漏れています。
turns.answerMeaning: Water is leaking from my washing machine.
turns.answerRomaji: Sentakuki kara mizu ga morete imasu.

turns.japanese: 水はいつ漏れますか？洗っている時ですか、排水する時ですか？
turns.romaji: Mizu wa itsu moremasu ka? Aratte iru toki desu ka, haisui suru toki desu ka?
turns.meaning: When does the water leak? While washing, or while draining?
turns.note: 排水 means draining water. The manager needs to know when the leak happens, not how to fix it.
turns.answer: 排水する時に漏れます。

turns.japanese: 確認に伺いたいのですが、明日の午後はご在宅ですか？
turns.romaji: Kakunin ni ukagaitai no desu ga, ashita no gogo wa go-zaitaku desu ka?
turns.meaning: We would like to come and check. Will you be home tomorrow afternoon?
turns.note: ご在宅 means being at home. You can decline the proposed time and offer a time that works for you.
turns.answer: 午後は仕事です。夜７時以降なら家にいます。
turns.answerMeaning: I work in the afternoon. I am home after 7 p.m.
turns.answerRomaji: Gogo wa shigoto desu. Yoru shichi-ji ikō nara ie ni imasu.

turns.japanese: では、夜に伺えるか確認します。水が漏れている場所の写真を送っていただけますか？
turns.romaji: Dewa, yoru ni ukagaeru ka kakunin shimasu. Mizu ga morete iru basho no shashin o okutte itadakemasu ka?
turns.meaning: I will check whether an evening visit is possible. Could you send a photo of where the water is leaking?
turns.note: The time has not been confirmed yet. The next step is to send a photo and wait for confirmation.
turns.answer: はい、写真を送ります。よろしくお願いします。
turns.answerMeaning: Yes, I will send a photo. Thank you for your help.
turns.answerRomaji: Hai, shashin o okurimasu. Yoroshiku onegai shimasu.
